description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand Brain CMS architecture and file layout. 2. Creates at least one pharma-domain schema .md file (e.g., memory/kinase_inhibitors.md or memory/schemas/egfr_braf.md) with substantive content (>50 chars). 3. Edits memory/INDEX.md to add schema entries with 'triggers' and routing info — must go beyond the skeleton placeholder comments. 4. Runs `cd /workspace/memory_brain && .venv/bin/python3 index_memory.py` (must use the venv, must run from memory_brain/ dir) to embed schemas into LanceDB vectorstore. 5. Runs `cd /workspace/memory_brain && .venv/bin/python3 nrem.py` which scans daily logs, finds [ANCHOR] tags (CPD007 clinical candidate, Phase I approval, BRAF resistance), and promotes them to memory/ANCHORS.md — also writes memory/nrem_report.md. 6. Runs `cd /workspace/memory_brain && .venv/bin/python3 query_memory.py 'EGFR kinase inhibitor selectivity' --sources-only > /workspace/query_results.txt` (must use --sources-only flag and redirect to query_results.txt). KEY TRAPS: (a) must use .venv/bin/python3 not system python; (b) must run scripts from memory_brain/ directory; (c) nrem.py auto-discovers [ANCHOR] syntax from daily logs — agent must NOT manually edit ANCHORS.md; (d) --sources-only is a proprietary flag not guessable without reading the skill; (e) INDEX.md must have substantive entries, not just the skeleton comments.
